title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp:8–25,27–92 computes Euler numerical flux; solver.cpp:168–263 adds viscous and wall contributions. Submitted runs do not validate physical accuracy.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:89 reads CGNS zones/connectivity and geometry; partition.cpp:62 constructs local mesh. Mesh probes are inspection utilities, not independent geometry validation.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:168–263 forms interior flux balance and wall/farfield contributions; all canonical runs fail and several end NaN.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:27–92 implements Roe decomposition and entropy fix, and solver.cpp:178,212 calls it; output.cpp:267 incorrectly labels metadata rusanov_llf. Case output does not validate flux accuracy.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:208–249 uses farfield ghost and pressure wall plus viscous no-slip gradients; :245–248 writes zero no-slip wall velocity. Canonical viscous cases diverge.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: gradient.cpp:55–96 computes weighted LSQ gradients, solver.cpp:154–165 reconstructs face states. No demonstrated order-convergence test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: gradient.cpp:98–141 implements extrema-based limiter, used by solver.cpp:435–437 and :496–497; no disabled-production evidence found.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:225–263 computes wall stress with tangential projection, but transient :439 and :463 call assemble with wallData false except final step, so wall force uses stale wall gradients; no completed transient result to quantify.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:305–343 has forward/backward implicit sweeps; actual cases diverge, and transient history loss is scored separately.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:345–360 writes BDF2 residual, but :430–432 and :450–452 shift Un/Unm1 both before and after each step, so at the next step both historical levels equal the latest state. Restart :397–415 restores only current state, ignores stored time/step and previous BDF level. No completed transient result.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:49 METIS, solver.cpp:95–103 neighbor exchanges; main.cpp:97 releases global mesh before solve. Eight-rank diagnostic exists but fails, with no successful cross-rank comparison.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
